results.criterion: With Surveyor configuration open and Username, Cancel, and Add layer visible, enter `TEST2-showcase-unsaved` and verify the complete value is visibly present in Username before cancelling.
steps_taken: Navigated to the launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS, then Surveyor configuration using the catalogue control.
Verified Username, Cancel and Add layer were visible.
Entered TEST2-showcase-unsaved and verified the complete value was visible; captured final assertion and current URL.
Selected Cancel for cleanup and verified the dialog closed.
results.observedResult: The entire TEST2-showcase-unsaved value was visibly present in Username, with Cancel and Add layer visible.

results.criterion: After selecting Cancel and reopening Surveyor configuration, verify Username is empty while Cancel and Add layer remain available.
steps_taken: Navigated to the launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS, then Surveyor configuration; captured before edit.
Entered TEST2-showcase-unsaved and verified the visible complete value.
Selected Cancel, verified the dialog closed and captured the closed state.
Reopened Surveyor configuration and verified Username was empty with Cancel and Add layer available; captured final assertion and current URL.
Cancelled the reopened dialog and captured cleanup.
results.observedResult: Reopened Username was empty; Cancel and Add layer remained available.

results.criterion: After cancelling the reopened dialog, verify the unobscured map view and complete Map layers entries and order match the original pre-dialog baseline, with no new Surveyor layer.
steps_taken: Navigated to the launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for the settled map; captured the unobscured map and complete one-entry Map layers baseline: ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas.

A stale element reference failed without changing state; subsequent edit/cancel calls found no dialog. Refreshed the snapshot and opened Surveyor successfully. Unchanged-state captures from unsuccessful calls are excluded.
Captured the first open dialog, entered TEST2-showcase-unsaved and verified the complete visible value.
Cancelled the edited dialog and captured the closed map state.
Reopened Surveyor configuration, verified Username was empty and captured the state before final Cancel.
Cancelled the reopened dialog, verified the unobscured map and complete Map layers list matched the original baseline, captured final evidence and current URL.
results.observedResult: Map extent, scale and visible content matched the pre-dialog baseline (Mapbox feedback location /-0.19456/50.85221/13.67). Complete layer list remained the single ALL Coverage Gap Candidate Areas entry; no Surveyor layer was added. The pre-existing coverage gap load alert was unchanged.

conciseReport: All three criteria passed with independent launcher starts and criterion-owned PNG evidence. Cancel discarded the synthetic Username edit; reopening showed an empty field; final map and complete layer list matched the baseline. Dialogs were left closed and pre-existing state preserved. The existing coverage gap data load alert did not prevent these assertions. A stale browser reference during criterion 3 was recovered before the successful continuous edit/cancel/reopen/cancel sequence.
